modalities.evidence: The T1w and T2w anatomical volumes and manual segmentations

output.population: 21 baboon subjects across 4 sessions; only sub-Prune published without embargo
output.summary: Multimodal baboon neuroimaging across four sessions, with a dedicated T1w/T2w template, probabilistic tissue atlases, interpolated between-session templates, and manual white matter, grey matter and CSF segmentations for one subject released without embargo.
